bug_semantics: An unauthenticated caller can POST attacker-controlled JSON to the intentionally public webhook trigger. The automation orchestrator templates that trigger context into an EXECUTE_QUERY step, and Snowflake was not in the SQL-datasource allowlist, so the query thread used enrichQueryFields with noEscaping=true and produced attacker-influenced SQL text. The initial Snowflake integration then sent query.sql directly as snowflake-sdk sqlText without driver binds, under the datasource's builder-configured credentials. This permits SQL injection and writes; a synchronous automation with COLLECT can also return query rows to the caller.
flaw_origin: Commit 570aeecdc3f6600b4dec279d588a704b1d4c8e60 first added packages/server/src/integrations/snowflake.ts. Its read method passed the already raw-enriched query.sql directly to snowflake-sdk as sqlText and supplied no binds. The public webhook route, EXECUTE_QUERY automation step, and processObject templating path already existed in the direct parent, so adding this Snowflake execution sink completed the advisory's vulnerable chain. Later changes only expanded or refactored that sink until the binding-forwarding fix.

evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/security/advisories/GHSA-x7h8-ww3q-xv7c documents the public POST /api/webhooks/trigger/:instance/:id route, webhook-body trigger context, EXECUTE_QUERY templating, Snowflake sqlText sink, affected <3.40.0, and patched 3.40.0; the assigned alias is https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-x389-5jg5-q6vh (CVE-2026-72851). At advisory snapshot 3c8d1b4023e17b4a7a5e7ca2307ef9de371a3632, packages/server/src/api/routes/webhook.ts, packages/server/src/api/controllers/webhook.ts, packages/server/src/automations/triggers.ts, packages/server/src/threads/automation.ts, packages/server/src/automations/steps/executeQuery.ts, packages/server/src/threads/query.ts, and packages/server/src/integrations/snowflake.ts form that path. git show of 570aeecdc3f6600b4dec279d588a704b1d4c8e60 (https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/commit/570aeecdc3f6600b4dec279d588a704b1d4c8e60) shows a new packages/server/src/integrations/snowflake.ts whose read method calls client.execute with sqlText: query.sql and no binds. At that revision packages/server/src/threads/query.js classifies only POSTGRES, SQL_SERVER, MYSQL, and ORACLE as SQL; Snowflake therefore uses packages/server/src/integrations/queries/sql.ts enrichQueryFields, which invokes processStringSync with noEscaping: true. Direct-parent tree verification with git cat-file -e 3a56712d621d34d23fb4924445b0b15156bee138:packages/server/src/integrations/snowflake.ts fails because the path is absent, while git grep in that same parent confirms packages/server/src/api/routes/webhook.js already exposes the unauthenticated trigger, packages/server/src/automations/actions.js already registers EXECUTE_QUERY, packages/server/src/threads/automation.js already processObject-templates step inputs, and packages/server/src/automations/steps/executeQuery.js already forwards inputs.query parameters to query execution. git log -L traces the later query.sql-only Snowflake sink through 534cc9e6c84da93e92609462c53ed6ed0fdb6878 and 970e7ee3e79bb3a1322fad0f530680c24d1b9764 as expansion/refactoring, not origin. The direct fix 7eca8c45bee665f1ee177603ddc5e8248a6a39d9 (https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/commit/7eca8c45bee665f1ee177603ddc5e8248a6a39d9) changes SnowflakePromise.execute to accept bindings, passes them as snowflake-sdk binds, and changes internalQuery to call execute(query.sql, query.bindings), with a regression test asserting sqlText plus binds. Version ancestry shows BIC absent from v1.0.191 and present in first containing prerelease v1.0.192-alpha.2 and stable v1.0.220. The advisory snapshot precedes the fix. The fix is absent from tag 3.39.23, present in 3.39.24, and present in the declared patched tag 3.40.0 (661fe55d609404d073eea86702e0bde7942c3f10); thus repository history reveals an earlier effective 3.39.24 boundary even though the public advisory conservatively declares 3.40.0. Exact BIC commit-object inspection used git cat-file commit 570aeecdc3f6600b4dec279d588a704b1d4c8e60 and found no AI marker. fix_sha corrected from 7eca8c45bee665f1ee177603ddc5e8248a6a39d9 to null — advisory UNPATCHED (reconciliation 2026-08-29: P names 7eca8c45bee6 ('Forward Snowflake query bindings', Dom Barker). git show 7eca8c45: only forwards binds: bindings to query. isSQL() in packages/shared-core/src/helpers/integrations.ts = [POSTGRES, SQL_SERVER, MYSQL, ORACLE] at 3.40.0, 3.41.1, AND HEAD — SNOWFLAKE never adde) fix_sha set to null — UNPATCHED confirmed: SNOWFLAKE never added to isSQL (reconciliation 2026-08-29). direct_fix_sha set to null (reconciliation 2026-08-29): 7eca8c45 only forwards binds; SNOWFLAKE was never added to isSQL — UNPATCHED.
reasoning: Field reconciliation 2026-08-29 (see evidence tail). Field reconciliation 2026-08-29 (see evidence tail). The vulnerable behavior is the conjunction of a pre-existing public webhook/automation path and a raw Snowflake SQL execution sink. The direct parent already allowed attacker-controlled webhook fields to reach templated EXECUTE_QUERY inputs, but it had no Snowflake integration at all. The smallest commit that first completed the Snowflake-specific SQL-injection chain is therefore the one-file initial integration commit 570aeecdc3f6600b4dec279d588a704b1d4c8e60, not later CRUD expansion, moves, TypeScript conversions, or the 2022 automation auth-config changes. Its immediate parent proves the vulnerable Snowflake file and sqlText sink absent. Commit 7eca8c45bee665f1ee177603ddc5e8248a6a39d9 directly neutralizes the sink by forwarding parameter bindings to the Snowflake driver, and tag ancestry places that change in 3.39.24 and the advertised 3.40.0 patch boundary. Because the exact BIC commit object is a conventional human-authored Mel O'Hagan commit with no AI authorship, co-authorship, generation trailer, or bot marker, the BIC-only attribution rule yields NOT_AI.
